statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit. The origin returned a successful but empty public document; no bot or authentication wall was observed.

page.notes: HTTP 200 with a zero-byte body; Chrome synthesizes an empty html/head/body DOM. No internal page archetypes or user flows are exposed.

checkOutcomes.method: Dark screenshot, DOM/CSS inspection, and computed-style probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark emulation leaves the blank canvas white; computed body colors are transparent/black and no color-scheme CSS exists.
Reduced-motion emulation is active and document.getAnimations() returns zero animations; no auto-advance or scripted motion exists.
Forced-colors/high-contrast capture contains no obscured controls or text because the response has no authored UI; native canvas remains visible.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No route, state change, or interactive element exists to transition.
checkOutcomes.reason: The empty single document exposes no state or route transition to evaluate.

checkOutcomes.evidence: There are no scripts, animations, scroll timelines, or scroll-linked effects, so no main-thread scroll-handler anti-pattern is present.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, popover, menu, dialog, or overlay exists.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The body is empty, with no H1, text, action, or visible purpose.

checkOutcomes.evidence: There are zero links and controls, so no primary flow can start or complete.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The main page is an empty 200 and a nonexistent path also returns 200 “empty OK”, with no error or recovery action.

axe reports no contrast violations and the page has no text or essential UI whose contrast can fail.

checkOutcomes.reason: No text is present to evaluate for legibility.

The document loads no scripts and exposes no inline event handlers; no executable page code exists to throw an uncaught page exception.

paths.description: Public entry page and only exposed page archetype. Audited because route/link recon found an empty single document.
Entry page under a narrow mobile viewport to assess viewport/reflow behavior.
Raw HTML, crawler rendering, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and manifest discovery. No content/listing/detail/form archetypes were found to add.
Representative missing-route recovery check; no other primary flow exists.

findings.summary: The public entry page is completely empty, so it communicates no purpose and offers no next action.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence is <html><head></head><body></body></html>; desktop, mobile, rendered, and crawler screenshots are blank; the HTTP 200 response body is 0 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish meaningful server-rendered content with a clear H1, concise purpose statement, primary action, and real navigation. Return an intentional maintenance or error response if no site should be available.

findings.summary: There is no primary journey to begin or complete.
findings.evidence: The document probe found zero links, zero controls, zero headings, zero body children, and empty body text.
findings.suggestedFix: Define the site’s core user journey, expose its first step as a semantic link or button, and implement an end-to-end path with visible progress and completion.

findings.summary: Unknown and reserved routes return HTTP 200 with “empty OK” instead of an honest, recoverable error state.
findings.evidence: The route probe received 200 text/plain “empty OK” for sitemap.xml, manifest.webmanifest, and a deliberately nonexistent path; the main document is an empty 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Return correct status codes and useful HTML error pages with a clear explanation, retry/home actions, and accessible status messaging.

findings.summary: The page does not adapt its canvas to the requested dark color scheme.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark, the screenshot remains white and computed body colors remain transparent background with black text; there is no authored CSS or color-scheme declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and define light/dark surface and text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() when publishing the page UI.

findings.summary: The page omits the viewport meta tag, so a 360px device is rendered on a 980px layout viewport and scaled down.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 layout capture reports hasViewportMeta=false, clientWidth=980, and scale=0.367; the DOM has no viewport meta.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and build the eventual layout with fluid intrinsic sizing and reflow.

findings.summary: The page never produces a contentful paint, so meaningful loading performance cannot satisfy the Core Web Vitals outcome.
findings.evidence: The trace records FCP=null and LCP=null; Lighthouse terminates with NO_FCP (“The page did not paint any content”).
findings.suggestedFix: Render meaningful HTML immediately, prioritize the primary content, and then measure LCP/INP/CLS on that real experience.

findings.summary: The document has no heading, main landmark, language declaration, or focusable path through content.
findings.evidence: axe reports document-title, html-has-lang, landmark-one-main, and page-has-heading-one violations; the runtime probe found zero focusable elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a semantic document structure with html lang, one main landmark, a logical heading hierarchy, and keyboard-focusable semantic controls with visible focus.

findings.summary: The response is not a sound authored HTML document: it has no doctype or charset declaration.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe reports doctype=null and the browser falls back to windows-1252; raw response size is 0 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a complete HTML5 document beginning with <!doctype html> and an early <meta charset="utf-8">.

findings.summary: The public page has neither a title nor a meta description.
findings.evidence: DOM and discoverability evidence report an empty title, no meta description, and no H1 in both raw and rendered representations.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique descriptive title and concise meta description that match the visible page purpose.

findings.summary: The site exposes no crawlable links or content and omits mobile viewport configuration.
findings.evidence: Document probe found zero links and no viewport meta; discoverability found zero raw and rendered content tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish indexable HTML content, use descriptive <a href> navigation, add the viewport meta tag, and keep robots policy aligned with intended discovery.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are internally misleading: nonexistent routes and sitemap.xml return successful placeholder responses, and the page has no canonical URL.
findings.evidence: The route probe reports HTTP 200 “empty OK” for sitemap.xml and a nonexistent path; the DOM has no canonical or hreflang links.
findings.suggestedFix: Return 404 for missing URLs, serve a valid XML sitemap for real canonical pages, and add canonical links where duplicate URL variants may exist.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but the main GET response lacks core security headers.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive reports missing CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Configure a restrictive CSP, durable HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and a minimal Permissions-Policy on document responses.

findings.evidence: The header audit finds no clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS, or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Define least-privilege browser policies at the edge/server and verify them on the final HTML response, not only on HEAD requests.

findings.summary: There is no core content with or without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: The discoverability primitive fetched a 0-byte raw HTML response and rendered an empty DOM; browser and crawler screenshots are identically blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the core purpose, navigation, and primary action as resilient HTML; layer JavaScript enhancements on top rather than starting from an empty response.

findings.summary: The document does not declare its language or direction.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe reports html lang=null and dir=null; axe flags html-has-lang as serious.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct lang on html, add dir where needed, and use logical CSS properties in the eventual layout.

taskList.title: Publish a meaningful resilient HTML page and core journey
Return honest statuses and recoverable error pages
Add the HTML document, accessibility, and mobile foundations
Add title, description, canonical navigation, and a valid sitemap
Configure browser security headers on the final GET response
Respect the user’s light/dark color preference
